launcher.title: Getting started
launcher.none: There are no walkthroughs for your role yet.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{product}}
welcome.description: A short tour of your locations, your pages and how to find assets. Replay it any time from Help in your profile.

moved.title: What's new in {{product}}
moved.description: Pages are in the side menu, setup is under Admin, and your location is at the top. Take a quick tour to find everything.

highlights.see: See them on maps and floor plans

tour.title: Welcome tour
tour.toggle: Show the welcome tour when I sign in
tour.description: On until you finish the tour or choose to explore on your own. Turn it back on to be greeted again at your next sign-in, with your guide progress reset.

starter.title: Get oriented
starter.summary: The layout, the pages, and how to find assets.

concept.title: How your space is organized
concept.description: Everything sits in one tree of locations. Pick one here, and every page shows that location and what's inside it:
concept.client: A company. Everything else sits inside one.
concept.building: A site, like a warehouse, plant or office.
concept.floor: A level in a building. It can have a floor map.
concept.zone: An area on a floor, like Receiving. The most precise location.

topbar.title: The header
topbar.description: Every page shows the location you picked here.
topbar.description_named: Every page shows what's in {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}}, the location you picked.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: An overview of this location: assets by status and type, and device activity.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: The things you track. Search, filter and find them on the map.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The trackers and repeaters that report data.

users.title: Users
users.description: Who has access, and what they can do. Under Admin.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Alerts for when something happens. Under Admin.

settings.title: Admin
settings.description: Set up this location: places, people, branding, assets, rules and security.

search.title: Find anything
search.description: Search by name or any detail.
search.description_named: Search {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}} by name or any detail.

open.title: Open the filters
open.description: Filters narrow the list and the map.

statusMeanings.IN_TRANSIT: On the move, or not in any building.
statusMeanings.MISSING: Not heard from for too long.

type.title: Asset type
type.description: Show one kind of asset, like forklifts.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: Show readings too imprecise for the floor map. They're hidden by default.

device.title: Device attachment
device.description: Show assets with or without a tracker.

apply.title: Back to the list
apply.description: Close the filters to see the results. Your filters stay on.

table.title: The asset list
table.description: Click an asset to open it. No assets yet? Next appears in a moment.
table.description_named: Every asset in {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}}. Click one to open it. No assets yet? Next appears in a moment.

details.title: Asset details
details.description: Its status, location, properties and devices. Edit it from here.

locate.title: See it on the map
locate.description: Where it is now, on the map or floor plan.

history.title: Where it has been
history.description: Where it has been. Click a row to see that moment on the map.

done.title: You're all set
done.description: Replay this tour or try the others any time from Help in your profile.

find.label: Find
find.description: Jump to any asset, device or place.

profile.label: Your profile
profile.description: Your settings, help and these tours.

context.title: Pick where it goes
context.description: In the place picker, pick the platform, or a client to add one inside it.

done.title: Client created
done.description: Pick it in the place picker to add buildings inside it.

sidebar.title: It's in the place picker
sidebar.description: Your client now appears here. Select it, and everything you add next goes inside it.

building.title: Add a building
building.summary: Add a site to a client.

context.title: Pick a client
context.description: Buildings go inside a client. Pick one in the place picker.

open.title: Add a building
open.description: Add a building to this client.

done.title: Building created
done.description: Pick it in the place picker to add floors.

sidebar.title: The tree grows
sidebar.description: The building now sits under your client. The hierarchy fills in as you go.

topbar.title: Everything follows your selection
topbar.description: The header shows your location. Whatever you pick in the place picker decides the assets, devices, and access you see.

floor.title: Add a floor
floor.summary: Add a floor to a building.

context.title: Pick a building
context.description: Floors go inside a building. Pick one in the place picker.

open.title: Add a floor
open.description: Add a floor to this building.

done.title: Floor created
done.description: Pick it in the place picker to add zones.

zone.title: Add a zone
zone.summary: Add an area to a floor.

context.title: Pick a floor
context.description: Zones go inside a floor. Pick one in the place picker.

open.title: Add a zone
open.description: Add a zone to this floor.

name.title: Name it
name.description: Name the zone, then finish the form.

done.title: Done
done.description: Finish the form to create the zone. That completes the tree: client, building, floor and zone.

assetType.title: Create an asset type
assetType.summary: A template for one kind of asset.

concept.title: How it fits together
concept.description: You'll set these up in order:

selectOwner.title: Pick a client
selectOwner.description: Asset types belong to a client. Pick one, or a location inside it.

openSettings.title: Fields live in Asset setup
openSettings.description: The fields themselves are set up in Admin › Asset setup, not on the Assets page. Open Admin, then Asset setup.

settingsTab.title: Asset settings
settingsTab.description: Click the Assets tab. Everything you set up once for this company lives here.

configCard.title: Two things to set up
configCard.description: Property definitions are the fields you can use. Asset types are the templates that require them. Both belong to the company, so every building, floor and zone inside it shares the same ones.

definitionsList.title: Your fields
definitionsList.description: Each field can be used on any asset type. Create one.

definitionName.title: Name the field
definitionName.description: What people see, like Serial Number. The key fills in by itself.

definitionsDone.title: Field ready
definitionsDone.description: Click Close once you have the fields you need. Settings stays open behind it, and next you will build a type that uses them.

openAssets.title: Open Assets
openAssets.description: Asset types are managed on the Assets page. Click Assets in the menu.

name.title: Name it
name.description: The kind of asset, like Forklift.

color.title: Color
color.description: Optional. Helps you spot this type.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: The fields every asset of this type must fill in.

closeManager.title: Close the manager
closeManager.description: Click Close to get back to the Assets page. Your new type is already saved.

filter.title: Types are filters too
filter.description: On the Assets page, filter by type to see one kind of asset.

openDashboard.title: See it on the Dashboard
openDashboard.description: Open the Dashboard. Its charts group assets by type.

widgetByType.title: Assets by type
widgetByType.description: How many assets of each type. A new type appears once it has assets.

widgetDwell.title: Avg dwell and transit time
widgetDwell.description: How long each type stays put, and how long it spends moving.

text.label: Text
text.description: Short text, like a serial number.

number.label: Number
number.description: A number you can compare or chart.

date.label: Date
date.description: A date, like when it was bought.

dropdown.label: Dropdown
dropdown.description: One choice from a list you write.

definition.label: Property definition
definition.caption: A field, like Serial Number, defined once per client.

type.label: Asset type
type.caption: A template, like Forklift, that requires some fields.

asset.label: Asset
asset.caption: One real item of that type.

widgets.label: Dashboard widgets
widgets.caption: Charts that group your assets by type.

findAsset.title: Find an asset
findAsset.summary: Pick where to look, search, and see it on the map.

place.title: Pick where to look
place.description: Assets lists what's in the location you pick here. Pick a client to see everything, or a building or floor to narrow it down.
place.description_named: You're looking in {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}}. Pick a building or floor to narrow it down, or the client to see everything.

search.title: Search
search.description: Type its name or any detail. From any page, Find at the top searches too.
search.description_named: Type its name or any detail to search {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}}. From any page, Find at the top searches too.

found.title: There it is
found.description: Its details open here, and the map moves to where it is now.

createAsset.title: Add an asset
createAsset.summary: Add one real item to track.

concept.title: What an asset is
concept.description: One real item, like a single forklift. Its type sets its fields, and a tracker puts it on the map.

scoping.title: Assets have a home
scoping.description: A new asset belongs to the location you've picked.

selectOwner.title: Pick its home
selectOwner.description: In the place picker, pick where this asset belongs.

openAssets.title: Open Assets
openAssets.description_named: Open the Assets page. The asset will belong to {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}}.

wizard.title: Two steps
wizard.description: Step 1 is the item, step 2 is its device. Create is at the end.

name.title: Name it
name.description: Its name or ID, like Forklift #3.

type.title: Its type
type.description: Its type adds the fields it needs.

mandatory.title: Required fields
mandatory.description: Fill in the fields marked *. Next unlocks once they're done.

nextStep.title: On to step 2
nextStep.description: Go to step 2 to attach a device.

devicesStep.title: Attach a device
devicesStep.description: What the device reports becomes this asset's location and history. You can skip this and attach one later.

tracker.title: Trackers put it on the map
tracker.description: Only a tracker gives an asset a location:

finish.title: Create it
finish.description: Create the asset. It appears on the map once its tracker reports.

concept.title: What's a device?
concept.description: Hardware that reports data. Trackers send location and status; repeaters extend coverage.

selectOwner.title: Pick its home
selectOwner.description: In the place picker, pick where this device belongs.

openDevices.title: Open Devices
openDevices.description_named: Open the Devices page. The device will belong to {{ownerLevel}} {{ownerName}}.

attach.title: Attach it to an asset
attach.description: Attach it to an asset so its data counts for that asset. Do it from the asset's details.

context.title: Pick a client
context.description: These settings are per client. Pick one in the place picker.

open.title: Open Settings
open.description: Open Admin in the menu, then Settings. We'll wait here until you do.

assets.title: Asset setup
assets.summary: When quiet assets go missing, and location accuracy.

config.title: Asset configuration
config.description: Property definitions are the reusable fields your asset types can require. Asset types are the templates themselves. Both are managed from here.

inactivity.title: Inactivity
inactivity.description: When an asset stops reporting, its status changes after the times you set:

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: How precise a reading must be, in meters, to show on floor maps.

branding.title: Branding
branding.summary: Your client's name, logo and colors.

whitelabel.title: Your brand
whitelabel.description: Set the name, logo and favicon here, and the colors further down. You see changes before you save.

done.title: Applied everywhere
done.description: Everyone in this client sees it, including on their sign-in page.

preferences.title: Client defaults
preferences.summary: Defaults for everyone in this client.

autoExpand.title: Place picker
autoExpand.description: Choose whether its tree opens expanded or collapsed.

security.title: Sign-in & sessions
security.summary: How long an idle session lasts.

timeout.title: Session timeout
timeout.description: How long someone can be idle before being signed out.

create.title: Add someone to the team
create.summary: Create a user and set what they can do.

basic.title: Who they are
basic.description: Their name and email. The invitation goes to this email.

role.title: What they may do
role.description: What they can do. Pick the smallest role that fits.

level.title: Where they belong
level.description: A user belongs to the location you're in now:

external.title: Access elsewhere
external.description: Add access to one more location, with its own role. Remove it any time.

done.title: Done
done.description: Someone you create gets an invitation, and shows as pending until they accept.

save.title: Create the user
save.description: Create them to send the invitation, or cancel to keep exploring.

open.title: User groups
open.description: Groups decide who gets an alert. Open Admin, then User groups.

new.title: Make a group
new.description: Name it and add members. Rules can send their alerts to it.

home.label: Their location
home.description: They see it and everything inside it.

external.label: Access elsewhere
external.description: Optional: one more location, with its own role.

create.title: Build a rule
create.summary: Create a rule and turn it on.

concept.title: What a rule does
concept.description: It watches for an event and raises an alert:

selectOwner.title: Pick a location
selectOwner.description: A rule only watches the location it belongs to.

name.title: Name it
name.description: Name it for what it catches, like “Pump left the building”.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: The event that starts it. The choices depend on the location.

submit.title: Create it
submit.description: Create the rule to open it on its canvas.

canvas.title: The chain
canvas.description: Your trigger and its alert. Drag cards to move them.

insert.title: Add a step
insert.description: Click + on a line to add a step there.

select.title: Open a step
select.description: Click a card to set it up.

inspector.title: Step settings
inspector.description: Set up the selected step here.

save.title: Save
save.description: Save your changes. Nothing saves on its own.

enable.title: Turn it on
enable.description: In the list, the switch turns a rule on or off.

done.title: Done
done.description: Open a rule any time by clicking its row.

chain.title: How rules work
chain.summary: Read a rule's chain of steps.

list.title: Your rules
list.description: Each row is one rule: what starts it, and how serious its alert is.

create.title: New rules
create.description: A new rule starts from its trigger.

inspector.title: Set up a step
inspector.description: Checks compare a field to a value. Only fields an earlier step fetched are offered.

custom.title: Your own fields
custom.description: Your asset type fields can be checked too, once a Details step has fetched the asset.

done.title: That's it
done.description: Looking around changes nothing. A rule only changes when you save it.

trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.caption: Something happens, like an asset leaving.

enrich.label: Details
enrich.caption: Optional: fetch more about the asset or device.
